thread:
incidents-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected — ap-southeast-1 gateway. 5m error rate 14% (baseline 0.4%). Paging oncall.

julie_oncall: I'm on it. hitting alert dashboard now. can someone confirm if this is edge-only or upstream? @mike_infra @anna_sre

mike_infra: looking at ingress metrics — connection resets + upstream 503. tcp resets spike around 12:03 UTC. stacktrace-ish in logs shows `upstream prematurely closed connection` from edge-proxy.

anna_sre: copying logs. pattern looks like short-lived memory pressure on mlworkers? but 503s are gateway-level. sending initial hypothesis: sticky route sessions causing downstream connection saturation. will check session affinity config.

kevin_platform: fyi: no recent deploys in ap-southeast-1 in the last 40m. CI deploys are green. deploy-bot shows last infra change was a config roll two hours ago (LB sticky-session tweak).

julie_oncall: ok prioritize mitigation: 1) disable sticky session affinity on ap-southeast edge pool 2) shift ~30% traffic to apac-backup-edge pool via routing policy for 15m 3) bump circuit breaker thresholds on gateway from 100->200 concurrently. anyone object?

mike_infra: doing 1 now: `kubectl patch cm edge-config -n gateway --patch '{"data":{"sticky_sessions":"false"}}'` applying to ap-southeast-1 pool. will monitor.

anna_sre: starting 2 — creating a temporary traffic-steer rule. command:
```
rictl routing update --from region=ap-southeast-1 --to pool=apac-backup-edge --percent=30 --ttl=15m
```

support_lead: opening customer-facing note. initial impact: increased 5xx/gateway timeouts for ~12% of requests in APAC. CS team will message any customers who ping. @customer-success please stand by.

customer-success: acknowledged. drafting canned note: "We're aware of increased errors in APAC and are actively mitigating; updates every 15 minutes." will send to affected customers on the list.

julie_oncall: monitor graphs — watching 5xx trend. if it doesn't drop in 3 minutes we escalate to full region failover.

incidents-bot: SYSTEM: Routing change applied (id r-8b3f). sticky_sessions config applied (ap-southeast-1). Circuit breaker update queued.

mike_infra: circuit breaker patch applied. small risk: may increase downstream retries; leaving retry budget at 1.

anna_sre: quick log snippet showing conn reset pattern:
```
[2026-03-15T12:03:21Z] gateway edge-proxy: upstream reset (RST) code=104 peer=10.12.45.78:443
[2026-03-15T12:03:22Z] mlworker-3: OOM-killer triggered, killed process pid=8429
```

kevin_platform: OOM on mlworker implies either a memory leak or burst. but sticky sessions causing uneven connection distribution would make some workers hotter.

julie_oncall: 3m after steering — 5xx rate down to 5.2% (was 14). good signal but still higher than baseline. continue steering to 30% and keep sticky off. open runbook step to drain hot nodes.

mike_infra: draining problematic nodes now. `kubectl cordon mlworker-3 && kubectl drain mlworker-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` will rotate traffic off.

anna_sre: started heap profile capture for the OOM suspect nodes, sent to /mnt/logs/profiles. will share link in 30m.

support_lead: CS update sent to 12 customers. no major SLA violations yet but monitoring closely. I'll alert sales for any high-touch accounts.

deploy-bot: NOTE: Canary rollback not detected. No application deployments in target window.

julie_oncall: decision: keep traffic-steer in place for 30m total, continue draining and reprovisioning capacity. assign postmortem owner: @anna_sre. assign mitigation writeup to @mike_infra. I'll handle communications and timeline.

kevin_platform: one more mitigation we can do quickly — reduce per-connection keepalive timeout to free sockets faster. pushing that change to gateway as a hotfix now.

mike_infra: keepalive change applied. observing connection table clearing.

anna_sre: thanks everyone. 25m in — 5xx normalized to 0.6% and latency stable. mlworker autoscaler kicked in and added 4 replicas after drain.

julie_oncall: excellent. starting recovery checklist: revert temporary routing after 30m, re-enable sticky sessions only after verifying worker health, attach heap profiles to postmortem.

customer-success: sending final note to customers that errors have subsided; giving ETA for full postmortem in 48 hours.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: ap-southeast-1 partial gateway degradation mitigated. Summary and playbook link: https://internal.redwood/incident/3675000001

julie_oncall: postmortem owners: anna_sre (root cause + remediation), mike_infra (mitigation timeline + infra fixes). I'll run the RCA doc. tagging ops-runbook for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

kevin_platform: follow-ups: (1) revert or carefully re-roll sticky-session config with phased canary, (2) add autoscaler headroom for mlworkers in apac pools, (3) add synthetic alert for per-worker memory OOM rate.

anna_sre: noted. will file tickets and include profiling artefacts. thanks all for quick responses.

mike_infra: leaving channel but will be reachable. ping me for the deployment playbook.

julie_oncall: closing this thread in 1h unless follow-ups. great work team. :tada:
